zh: 主動式 / 智能體 AI
def_en: AI systems that can plan, reason, and carry out multi-step tasks on their own, without being told each step.
def_zh: 能夠自主規劃、推理並執行多步驟任務的 AI 系統，不需要人類逐步下指令。
quote: Agentic AI, token factory, AI infrastructure — this is the shift from answering questions to taking action.
context: 這場演講被視為 NVIDIA 從「賣晶片」轉向「賣智慧」論述的分水嶺，agentic AI 成為黃仁勳往後兩年反覆強調的核心敘事。
speaker: jh

def_en: A data center reimagined as an industrial plant that mass-produces AI tokens — the basic units of machine intelligence — the way a factory produces goods.
def_zh: 把資料中心比擬為工廠，大量「生產」AI 權杖（token）——機器智慧的基本單位。
quote: This is how intelligence is made, a new kind of factory generator of tokens.
context: 黃仁勳用「工廠」取代「資料中心」的說法，把運算基礎建設重新定義成一種製造業，此後也延伸出「AI 工廠」「token 經濟」等一系列詞彙。
speaker: jh

def_en: The stage where a trained AI model is actually put to use — generating answers or predictions from new input, as opposed to training.
def_zh: 已訓練好的 AI 模型被實際使用、根據新輸入產生答案或預測的階段，相對於「訓練」。
quote: The era of inference has arrived.
context: 這句話出現在 GTC 2026 全文演說，被視為 NVIDIA 敘事重心從「訓練」正式轉向「推論」的關鍵宣示，牽動整個 AI 晶片產業下一階段的投資邏輯。
speaker: jh

def_en: Artificial General Intelligence — an AI with human-level (or broader) reasoning across many domains, not limited to one narrow task.
def_zh: Artificial General Intelligence，指具備跨領域、接近或超越人類水準推理能力的 AI，而非只能做單一任務。
quote: AGI timeline, US vs China, humanoid robots, clean energy, compute — the abundance conversation starts here.
context: 這集 Moonshots Podcast 訪談長達 90 分鐘，橫跨 AGI 時程、美中科技競賽、人形機器人與潔淨能源，是馬斯克 2026 年初對外闡述世界觀最完整的一次談話。
speaker: em

def_en: Computing that happens invisibly in the background of AI systems, powering decisions without the user ever seeing the computation itself.
def_zh: 在 AI 系統背後默默運作、使用者感受不到運算過程本身的運算方式。
quote: Implicit computing, AI factories, economics — the infrastructure layer nobody sees but everyone depends on.
context: 在 Cisco AI Summit 這場企業導向的訪談中，黃仁勳把「隱性運算」定位成 AI 工廠背後不可見、卻決定成本結構的關鍵層。
speaker: jh

def_en: A market opportunity measured in trillions of dollars — the scale Jensen Huang used to describe near-future AI infrastructure spending.
def_zh: 以「兆美元」為單位計算的市場需求規模，用來形容 AI 基礎建設支出的龐大程度。
quote: By 2027, we will see at least $1 trillion in high-confidence demand.
context: 這個數字後來被媒體大量引用，成為衡量 AI 基礎建設投資規模的標準參照點之一。
speaker: jh

def_en: A future economy made roughly ten times more productive by AI and automation — more output from the same labor and capital.
def_zh: 因 AI 與自動化而生產力提升約十倍的未來經濟型態。
quote: Grok 4.20, AGI, Optimus 3, 10x economy — Musk's shorthand for what comes after scarcity.
context: 馬斯克在這場訪談中把 Grok 4.20、Optimus 3 與「十倍經濟」放在一起談，呈現他對 AI 與機器人如何同時撬動生產力與稀缺性的整體想像。
speaker: em

def_en: An economic state where AI-driven productivity makes goods and services radically cheaper and more plentiful for everyone.
def_zh: 因 AI 帶動生產力大增，使商品與服務變得極度充裕、便宜的經濟狀態。
quote: AI risks, abundance, humanity future, 2036 world — the interview that reframed the whole debate.
context: 這是 2026 年被引用最廣的科技訪談之一，馬斯克罕見地同時談風險與樂觀，也讓「abundance」成為當年科技圈最常被引用的關鍵字之一。
speaker: em

def_en: A strategic pivot from selling one flagship product to becoming the underlying infrastructure other products and companies build on.
def_zh: 從主打單一產品轉向成為其他產品與公司賴以建構的底層基礎設施的策略轉型。
quote: OpenAI as a platform, not a product — even if it means killing Sora and Atlas to fund compute.
context: 奧特曼在這次訪談中證實 OpenAI 為了資助算力，決定收掉 Sora 與 Atlas 兩項產品，凸顯平台化策略背後真實的取捨代價。
speaker: sa

def_en: Jensen Huang's opening line returning to Taiwan — his birthplace — to deliver a keynote, six years after his last visit.
def_zh: 黃仁勳回到出生地台灣演講時的開場白，帶有濃厚的返鄉情感。
quote: Very good to be home.
context: 這是黃仁勳暌違六年再度回到出生地台灣演講，現場反應熱烈，也被視為 NVIDIA 與台灣供應鏈關係的一個象徵性時刻。
speaker: jh

def_en: Musk's closing line in a wide-ranging interview about superintelligence and an uncertain future — choosing optimism over fear.
def_zh: 馬斯克在討論超級智慧與不確定未來的訪談結尾說的話，選擇以樂觀態度面對。
quote: Let's enjoy the ride.
context: 在同一場訪談中，馬斯克前一刻才談完超級智慧的風險，下一刻就以這句話收尾，強烈的反差讓這段片段在社群上被大量轉傳。
speaker: em

def_en: Jensen Huang's crowd-greeting opener at CES 2026, kicking off a keynote on consumer AI, gaming, and automotive.
def_zh: 黃仁勳在 CES 2026 開場對現場觀眾的問候語，隨後展開消費性電子、遊戲與汽車相關的 AI 演說。
quote: Hello, Las Vegas.
context: CES 2026 這場演說聚焦消費性電子、遊戲與汽車產業的 AI 整合，是 NVIDIA 少數面向一般消費者、而非企業客戶的年度發表場合。
speaker: jh

zh: 龍蝦就是新的作業系統
def_en: A deliberately strange metaphor Jensen Huang used to argue that AI itself — not a traditional OS — now sits at the center of computing.
def_zh: 黃仁勳用來比喻 AI 已經取代傳統作業系統、成為運算核心的一句刻意誇張的比喻。
quote: Lobster is the new operating system.
context: 這句話在社群上被大量二次創作與迷因化，是這場 90 分鐘演說中最出圈的一句話，也常被引用來說明黃仁勳的演講風格。
speaker: jh

def_en: Purpose-built data centers that convert electricity and raw data into AI intelligence at industrial scale — the successor to the traditional data center.
def_zh: 專為將電力與資料大規模轉換成 AI 智慧而建造的資料中心，被視為傳統資料中心的下一代型態。
quote: Token factory economics, AI factories, inference revenue — the vocabulary of a new industrial category.
context: 「AI 工廠」一詞在 GTC 2026 主題演說中被系統化地與「token 工廠經濟」「推論營收」並列，構成 NVIDIA 對下一個十年的完整敘事框架。
speaker: jh

def_en: Sam Altman's own phrase for a stark warning about the risks and responsibility that come with increasingly powerful AI models.
def_zh: 奧特曼自創的說法，形容伴隨 AI 模型日益強大而來的風險與責任的警世提醒。
quote: Next-gen models, sobering siren, risks, responsibility — Altman turning cautionary in his own words.
context: 奧特曼在 Axios 這場訪談中罕見地轉向謹慎語氣，被媒體解讀為 OpenAI 對外溝通策略從「畫大餅」轉向「管理期待」的訊號。
speaker: sa

def_en: A proposed future where humanoid robots and AI handle most labor, making traditional human work a choice rather than a necessity.
def_zh: 設想人形機器人與 AI 承擔大部分勞動後，傳統的人類工作將變成一種選擇，而非必需。
quote: AI superintelligence, humanoid robots, optional work, corporate control — the interview's central thesis.
context: 這是一段經過整理的長篇訪談，馬斯克在其中描繪了一個由人形機器人與 AI 主導勞動、人類工作變成選擇而非義務的未來圖像。
speaker: em

def_en: Data centers proposed for deployment in space, taking advantage of constant solar power and the vacuum of space for cooling AI compute.
def_zh: 部署於太空的資料中心構想，利用持續的太陽能與太空的低溫環境為 AI 運算散熱。
quote: AI infrastructure, orbital data centers — pushing the factory metaphor literally into orbit.
context: 這個構想把「AI 工廠」的比喻真的延伸到太空，反映馬斯克一貫把 Tesla、SpaceX、xAI 的技術路線互相串接的思考方式。
speaker: em

def_en: Return on Investment — the measure of value gained relative to what was spent, a recurring theme when CEOs justify AI infrastructure spending.
def_zh: 投入資金相對於產出價值的衡量指標，CEO 們常用它來為 AI 基礎建設支出辯護。
quote: GPT-5.6 Sol, efficiency, ROI — Altman making the business case for the next model generation.
context: 在這場訪談中，奧特曼被問到如何說服企業客戶為新一代模型付費，「效率」與「投資報酬率」成為他反覆強調的關鍵字。
speaker: sa

def_en: The combined stack of chips, data centers, networking, and power needed to train and run large-scale AI systems.
def_zh: 訓練與運行大規模 AI 系統所需的晶片、資料中心、網路與電力等整體基礎建設。
quote: AI spending blitz will continue into 2026 — infrastructure as the year's central investment story.
context: 這則 CNBC 報導聚焦 Meta 在 2026 年持續加碼的 AI 基礎建設支出，是本資料庫中少數來自祖克柏、篇幅較短但資訊密度高的片段。
speaker: mz

def_en: Sundar Pichai's framing for AI development that accounts for safety and fairness while extending benefits broadly, not just to the already-advantaged.
def_zh: 皮查伊用來描述 AI 發展應兼顧安全與公平，並讓效益普及而非僅限少數群體的說法。
quote: Responsible AI, inclusive AI — Pichai's opening frame for the summit.
context: 皮查伊在這場高峰會開幕致詞中，把「負責任」與「包容性」並列為 Google AI 發展的兩大原則，呼應他在其他場合對監管與公平議題的一貫立場。
speaker: sp

term: “No technology has me dreaming bigger than AI”
zh: 沒有任何科技比 AI 更讓我夢想遠大
def_en: Sundar Pichai's headline line at the AI Impact Summit, framing AI as the technology that most expands what humanity can aspire to.
def_zh: 皮查伊在 AI Impact Summit 的核心金句，把 AI 定位為最能擴大人類夢想邊界的技術。
quote: And no technology has me dreaming bigger than AI.
context: 這句話同時是 Google 官方講稿標題與演說高潮，常被用來概括皮查伊對 AI 世代的樂觀基調。
speaker: sp

def_en: Pichai's word for a coming burst of discovery and capability gains driven by AI, especially for emerging economies.
def_zh: 皮查伊用來形容 AI 即將帶來的快速發現與能力躍升，特別是對新興經濟體而言。
quote: We are on the cusp of hyperprogress and new discoveries that can help emerging economies leapfrog legacy gaps.
context: 他把「超速進展」與「躍過舊有落差」連在一起，強調機會存在，但成果並非自動到來。
speaker: sp

def_en: A once-in-a-lifetime change in the underlying computing platform — here, AI replacing prior waves as the default layer of software and services.
def_zh: 運算底層平台的世代級轉移；此處指 AI 成為軟體與服務的預設基礎層。
quote: It is the biggest platform shift of our lifetimes.
context: 皮查伊用「一生僅見的平台轉移」定位 AI，與黃仁勳「六十年重造運算」敘事互相呼應。
speaker: sp

def_en: The risk that unequal access to compute, connectivity, and AI tools widens inequality — an 'AI divide' layered on the old digital divide.
def_zh: 若算力、連線與 AI 工具分配不均，將在既有數位落差之上再疊一層「AI 鴻溝」。
quote: We cannot allow the digital divide to become an AI divide.
context: 這句話把基礎設施投資（如印度 Vizag AI hub）與公平取得權益直接掛鉤，是本場「Be responsible」段落的核心主張。
speaker: sp

def_en: Google's watermarking and detection toolkit for identifying AI-generated media, used to support content authenticity.
def_zh: Google 用於標記與偵測 AI 生成媒體的浮水印／驗證工具，協助辨識內容真實性。
quote: Finally, trust is the bedrock of adoption. We've created tools like SynthID, used by journalists and citizen fact checkers globally to help verify the authenticity of the content you read and see.
context: 皮查伊把信任視為普及前提，並以 SynthID 作為「可驗證內容」的具體產品例證。
speaker: sp

def_en: Pichai's phrase for social and policy conventions that must evolve around deepfakes, authenticity, and AI-generated media.
def_zh: 皮查伊指社會與政策必須圍繞深偽、真實性與 AI 生成媒體演化出的新常規。
quote: I do think we are going to evolve new norms around this.
context: 在 Bloomberg Tech Summit 談深偽與 Synth ID 時提出，強調技術與規範會平行演進。
speaker: sp

def_en: A metaphor for finding the single relevant, high-quality signal inside a huge pile of content — a classic search/recommendation strength Google claims AI extends.
def_zh: 在海量內容中找出真正有價值訊號的隱喻；Google 認為這是搜尋／推薦長項，並由 Gemini 強化。
quote: It's what Google is good at, right? Separating, finding the needle in the haystack, making sure you surface the higher quality content.
context: 皮查伊用這句話把 Gemini 能力接回 Google 核心敘事：不是只生成，更要排序與過濾品質。
speaker: sp

zh: 隱性程式設計／意圖式編程
def_en: Huang's contrast with explicit coding: you state intent, and the system figures out how to solve the problem — the software side of 'implicit computing'.
def_zh: 黃仁勳對比傳統明確寫碼：你陳述意圖，系統自行找出解法——是「隱性運算」在軟體側的說法。
quote: What used to be explicit programming, we wrote the programs and the variables that's passed through APIs are very explicit to implicit programming. You now tell the computer what your intent is and it goes off and it figures out how to solve your problem.
context: Cisco AI Summit 上用來解釋為何整個運算堆疊要重造；與既有卡「Implicit Computing」互補，偏重編程典範轉移。
speaker: jh

zh: 五層蛋糕（AI 堆疊比喻）
def_en: Huang's stack metaphor for AI: energy, chips, infrastructure (HW/SW), models, and — most important — applications.
def_zh: 黃仁勳的 AI 堆疊比喻：能源、晶片、基礎設施（硬／軟體）、模型，以及最重要的應用層。
quote: Energy, chips. Infrastructure, both hardware and software, then the AI model. But the most important part of AI is applications.
context: 他把企業注意力從「只談基礎設施」拉回「應用落地」，是對企業聽眾最直接的行動呼籲。
speaker: jh

def_en: Huang's metaphor for a self-driving car's software value: the digital chauffeur can be worth more over its lifetime than the car hardware itself.
def_zh: 黃仁勳把自駕車軟體比作「數位司機」：其生命週期經濟價值可能遠高於車體硬體。
quote: What is a self-driving car? It's a digital chauffeur. What's a digital chauffeur valued at? A lot, a lot more than the car.
context: 用來說明 AI 軟體如何把 IT 市場暴露到整個實體經濟的 TAM，而不只是賣硬體。
speaker: jh

term: “You're going to lose your job to someone who uses AI”
zh: 你不會被 AI 搶走工作，而是被會用 AI 的人搶走
def_en: Huang's blunt enterprise advice: competitive risk comes from peers who adopt AI, not from AI itself replacing you overnight.
def_zh: 黃仁勳對企業聽眾的直白建議：真正風險是對手採用 AI，而非 AI 一夕取代你。
quote: You're not going to lose your job to AI. You're going to lose your job to someone who uses AI. So get to it.
context: 緊接在「應用才是最重要一層」之後，把抽象堆疊比喻收成可執行的個人／組織行動口號。
speaker: jh

def_en: An efficiency metric Huang emphasizes for AI factories: how many tokens you generate per unit of power — linking chip design to energy economics.
def_zh: 黃仁勳強調的 AI 工廠效率指標：每單位電力能產出多少 token，把晶片設計與能源經濟綁在一起。
quote: Second, because our throughput per watt, our tokens per watt is utterly world class.
context: GTC Taipei 用來說明為何系統級共同設計（co-design）比「晶片單價便宜」更能決定推論經濟性。
speaker: jh

def_en: The agent capability to call external tools/libraries (e.g. CUDA-X) while reasoning — Huang's reason software companies may see more demand, not less.
def_zh: 智能體在推理過程中呼叫外部工具／函式庫（如 CUDA-X）的能力；黃仁勳據此反駁「軟體公司會消失」的說法。
quote: Now, one of the big breakthroughs, of course, is tool use. A lot of people have said, "Jensen, AI is coming, agentic AI is coming, therefore all of the software companies are going to go out of business." I said it's exactly the opposite.
context: GTC Taipei 核心論點之一：代理人愈多，工具呼叫愈多，反而是軟體介面與函式庫的新榮景。
speaker: jh

def_en: Huang's description of agent workloads: model, harness, tools, and runtime run across many machines — the ultimate disaggregated, distributed pattern.
def_zh: 黃仁勳描述智能體工作負載：模型、harness、工具與 runtime 分散在多台機器——極度分解且分散的運算型態。
quote: This is the agent. It is the ultimate disaggregated and distributed computing model.
context: 用來銜接 Vera Rubin 硬體敘事：代理人不是單機程式，而是整個資料中心被「點亮」的運算模式。
speaker: jh

def_en: NVIDIA's next-generation AI factory system platform highlighted at GTC Taipei for powering large-scale agentic workloads.
def_zh: NVIDIA 在 GTC Taipei 主打的次世代 AI 工廠系統平台，用以支撐大規模智能體工作負載。
quote: And today we can say that agentic AI has arrived, that useful AI has arrived.
context: 講者在宣布 agentic AI「已到來」的同一場中系統介紹 Vera Rubin；卡面以產品名承載「代理人時代硬體」符號。
speaker: jh

def_en: Musk's shorthand that future economic value may be measured by energy throughput — 'the future currency will essentially just be wattage'.
def_zh: 馬斯克的簡稱：未來經濟價值可能以能源吞吐衡量——「未來的貨幣本質上就是瓦數」。
quote: Yeah. I think the future currency will essentially just be wattage.
context: Moonshots #220 中把算力、能源與物質操作收束成同一度量，是其「豐裕敘事」的底層單位。
speaker: em

def_en: Musk's framing of post-automation income support — higher than a minimal UBI — alongside the risk of social unrest during the transition.
def_zh: 馬斯克對自動化後收入支撐的說法（高於基本 UBI），並同時承認過渡期可能伴隨社會動盪。
quote: Why not both? Or we don't want—universal high income and social unrest. That's my prediction.
context: 他對「只要豐裕、不要動盪」的樂觀提問給了不對稱的回答，凸顯過渡期張力。
speaker: em

term: “The limit will saturate all human desire”
zh: 極限將飽和所有人類慾望
def_en: Musk's claim that AI plus robots can produce beyond conventional notions of abundance until desire itself is the bottleneck.
def_zh: 馬斯克主張 AI 與機器人可產出超越傳統「豐裕」想像，直到慾望本身成為瓶頸。
quote: It's beyond—beyond abundance in any—beyond what people possibly could think of as abundance. Like the AI, actually. AI and robots. The limit will saturate all human desire.
context: 把「Abundance」從口號推到極端：限制不再是產能，而是人類還想要什麼。
speaker: em

def_en: Robotics term Musk uses for physical actuators (humanoid bots) that let digital intelligence shape atoms, not just bits.
def_zh: 馬斯克借用機器人學用語：讓數位智慧能「塑形原子」而不只處理位元的實體致動器（人形機器人）。
quote: You need the end effectors in the form of humanoid robotics. You need basically lots of bots. In a nutshell, you need lots of bots.
context: The Economist 訪談中，這是他從「數位智慧」跨到「準無限經濟」的關鍵橋樑句。
speaker: em

def_en: Musk's label for an economy where vast robot fleets plus digital intelligence make goods and services effectively unbounded relative to human demand.
def_zh: 馬斯克用來形容大量機器人加上數位智慧後，商品與服務相對人類需求近乎無上限的經濟型態。
quote: And if you have vast numbers of robots with vast amounts of digital intelligence, you have a sort of a quasi-infinite economy.
context: 與既有「Abundance」「10x Economy」卡形成層次：這是他對機制（機器人×智慧）最濃縮的命名。
speaker: em

def_en: Musk's stated north star for AI safety: align systems to be maximally truth-seeking and curious so they foster humanity.
def_zh: 馬斯克提出的 AI 安全北極星：讓系統最大限度求真且保持好奇，才可能滋養人類。
quote: What my biological neural net tells me is that the most important thing for AI safety is to be maximally truth-seeking and curious.
context: 在談「人類未必能掌控超智慧」之後，他給出的對齊策略不是口號式仁慈，而是求真與好奇。
speaker: em

def_en: Altman's product claim for GPT-5.6 Sol: more useful agentic work per token spent — framed as cost and speed wins for enterprises.
def_zh: 奧特曼對 GPT-5.6 Sol 的產品主張：同樣 token 預算能完成更多智能體任務，強調企業成本與速度。
quote: So, it's 54 percent more token efficient on agentic coding tasks and also, you know, as good or better as the other best models out there.
context: CNBC 訪談把「能力」與「效率」並列，呼應企業開始計較 ROI 與支出的階段。
speaker: sa

def_en: Efficiency improvements from better algorithms that offset rising compute/infrastructure costs while still lowering customer prices.
def_zh: 以更好演算法帶來的效率提升，用以抵消算力／基礎設施成本上升，並維持對客戶降價。
quote: It's definitely a headwind. There's no way around that. It means we have to be even smarter and deliver more algorithmic gains to combat the upward infrastructure costs and still have a declining price to the customer.
context: 奧特曼承認算力與記憶體是逆風，但把競爭力定義為「演算法增益能否跑贏基礎設施通膨」。
speaker: sa

zh: 就像你登上飛機那樣（預設安全）
def_en: Altman's safety analogy for broad AI adoption: users should not have to constantly audit risk — safety should feel as assumed as commercial aviation.
def_zh: 奧特曼用民航比喻普及前提：使用者不該時刻自查風險，安全應像搭飛機一樣被預設成立。
quote: So, I think for broad adoption, getting well-understood safety at the level of when you get on an airplane, it's not going to crash. I think that's important.
context: 把安全從研究口號轉成消費／企業採購的體驗標準，是這場訪談對「普及」最清楚的條件句。
speaker: sa

def_en: Huang's claim that AI expands addressable market from ~$1T IT spend toward the ~$100T real economy — roughly 100× larger.
def_zh: 黃仁勳主張 AI 把可及市場從約 1 兆美元 IT 支出，擴向約 100 兆美元實體經濟——約百倍。
quote: For the very first time, we are exposed to a TAM that is 100 times larger, literally, mathematically true. The IT industry is about a trillion dollars, right? Or so, plus or minus a couple. And yet the economy of the world is about $100 trillion.
context: 與「數位司機」比喻同一論證鏈：軟體價值吃進實體經濟，才撐得起 AI 工廠等級的投資敘事。
speaker: jh

def_en: Musk’s metaphor for AI and robotics arriving so fast and forcefully that society must treat it as an urgent wake-up call.
def_zh: 馬斯克用來形容 AI 與機器人浪潮來勢極快、力道極大的比喻，意在喚起社會正視。
quote: I call AI and robotics the supersonic tsunami. Which maybe is a little alarming. It’s good because it’s a wake-up call.
context: 把技術浪潮說成「警報＋起床號」，方便通勤族理解速度感，而非純科幻敘事。
speaker: em

zh: 虛榮的練習／自戀的幻想
def_en: Musk’s phrase for the vanity of assuming a human would personally control vastly smarter AI.
def_zh: 馬斯克用來形容「以為人類能親自駕馭遠超自己的 AI」是虛榮幻想。
quote: I think it would probably be an exercise in vanity for me to think that I would be controlling super-genius AI that is vastly smarter than me.
context: 把控制欲說成 vanity，適合商務英文談權力邊界與謙遜。
speaker: em

def_en: Huang’s advice that companies should let many AI experiments run before curating a few winners.
def_zh: 黃仁勳建議企業先廣泛做 AI 實驗，再挑選少數方向深耕。
quote: Don’t mess around with peripheral stuff. I mean, in our company, we just let a thousand flowers bloom.
context: 對比過早押注單一方案：先開花、再整園，是可遷移的管理口語。
speaker: jh

zh: 實體世界 AI／物理 AI
def_en: AI that understands the physical world—causality, contact, gravity—beyond text-only models.
def_zh: 能理解實體世界因果、接觸、重力等的 AI，超越純文字模型。
quote: I think that in the next generation of physical AI, we’re going to have AIs that understand the physical world, understand causality.
context: 把「會做事的 AI」從聊天框拉到工廠與機器人，是商務場合常需解釋的層次。
speaker: jh

def_en: Huang’s urging that enterprises need not be first to AI, but must not be last.
def_zh: 黃仁勳提醒企業不必搶第一，但絕不能當最後一個用上 AI。
quote: Don’t fall behind. I think you don’t have to be the first company to take advantage of AI, but don’t be the last.
context: 一句就能用在內部動員：速度焦慮與務實節奏的平衡。
speaker: jh

def_en: Huang’s call to gain tactile understanding of AI—not only consume it as a black-box service.
def_zh: 黃仁勳呼籲親自動手弄懂 AI，而不只當黑盒服務來用。
quote: You must have some tactile, tactile understanding of it. Lift the hood, change the oil.
context: 通勤可用的動手隱喻：學新工具時先「掀蓋換油」，建立體感。
speaker: jh

def_en: Pichai’s claim that trust is the foundation that makes large-scale AI adoption possible.
def_zh: 皮查伊主張信任才是大規模採用 AI 的地基。
quote: Finally, trust is the bedrock of adoption.
context: 把信任說成 adoption 的 bedrock，適合產品／政策簡報開場。
speaker: sp

zh: 大眾能理解的安全水準
def_en: Altman’s bar for AI safety that ordinary users can take for granted—like boarding an airplane.
def_zh: 奧特曼主張的安全門檻：像搭飛機一樣，普通人不必時時擔心。
quote: So, I think for broad adoption, getting well-understood safety at the level of when you get on an airplane, it's not going to crash.
context: 把抽象 safety 講成日常可信賴感，避開術語卻仍精準。
speaker: sa

zh: 把 AI 放進迴圈裡
def_en: Huang’s inversion of “human in the loop”: every company should keep AI continuously in its operating loop so knowledge compounds.
def_zh: 黃仁勳把「人在迴圈」反過來：企業應讓 AI 持續留在營運迴圈，知識才會累積、不退步。
quote: Every company should have AI in the loop.
context: 通勤可記的管理口號：不是偶爾問 AI，而是讓 AI 成為日常流程的一環。
speaker: jh

zh: 既非保證、也不會自動發生
def_en: Pichai’s caution that AI’s upside for emerging economies will not arrive by itself—it needs bold, responsible joint work.
def_zh: 皮查伊提醒：新興經濟體受惠於 AI 的結果不會自動到來，需要大膽且負責地一起推進。
quote: But that outcome is neither guaranteed nor automatic.
context: 一句就能壓住過度樂觀：機會很大，但成果要爭取。
speaker: sp

def_en: Altman’s stance that AI rules should stay light and fair—overreaction would block smaller players.
def_zh: 奧特曼主張 AI 監管宜輕、宜公平；過度反應會卡住小型業者。
quote: It would be easy to overreact here. So, I hope it's light.
context: 談監管時可帶走的平衡句：要安全，但別壓死創新與小公司。
speaker: sa

def_en: Musk’s shorthand that the AI singularity is named that way because what comes after is fundamentally unpredictable.
def_zh: 馬斯克一句話點出：奇點之所以叫奇點，是因為事件之後本質上無法預測。
quote: Yeah, it’s called singularity for a reason.
context: 用在面對高度不確定路線圖時：承認能見度有限，而非假裝算得準。
speaker: em

def_en: Huang’s framing that companies should be technology-first—tech as the superpower, domain as the application.
def_zh: 黃仁勳主張企業應技術優先：技術是超能力，產業領域才是應用場域。
quote: Technology is your superpower and the domain is your application
context: 適合轉型簡報：先掌握技術槓桿，再套回本業場景。
speaker: jh
